settings.heading: Warmth and gentle massage, in one simple wrap.
settings.intro: Fasten it around the joint that bothers you, press a button, and choose what feels right. The screen shows the temperature and battery, so there's no guesswork.

settings.title: Wrap it around
settings.text: Place the pad over your knee, elbow or shoulder and fasten the soft straps until it feels snug. It locks in place — no holding it there.

settings.title: Pick your warmth
settings.text: Tap the screen to choose 45°C, 50°C or 65°C — and add one of the three massage settings if you fancy it.

settings.title: Sit back and relax
settings.text: Let the warmth settle in while you read, watch TV, or put the kettle on. Recharge by USB when the battery runs low.

settings.heading: Three simple steps to a warmer evening

settings.question: Will it fit me?
settings.answer: Yes, for most people — the adjustable straps (with a 68cm extension strap included) wrap comfortably around most legs and arms, snugger or looser as you prefer.

settings.question: Is it safe to use every day?
settings.answer: Yes — it's designed for regular use and is CE, FCC and RoHS certified. As with any heat product, follow the included guide, and check with your GP first if you have a health condition.

settings.question: Will this replace my doctor's treatment?
settings.answer: No. It's designed for warmth, gentle massage and comfort — not to treat, prevent or cure any condition. For ongoing joint pain, please speak to your GP.

settings.heading: Straight answers to the questions people actually have.
One for you — or share the comfort.
settings.subheading: Many customers buy a second for the other knee, or as a gift for a parent or partner.

settings.heading: Everything you'd want to check, spelled out.

settings.question: What does it actually do?
settings.answer: Two things: it warms (three settings — 45°C, 50°C and 65°C) and it massages (three vibration modes). You can use both together or either one on its own, for comfort after activity or at the end of a long day. It's not a medical device and doesn't treat any condition.

settings.question: How long does the battery last?
settings.answer: The built-in 4000mAh rechargeable battery gives you several sessions before it needs topping up. It charges by USB with the included 1-metre cable, so it's easy to top up anywhere.

settings.question: What sizes does it fit?
settings.answer: The adjustable straps fit most adult legs and arms, and a 68cm extension strap is included for the shoulder or larger legs. If you're unsure, our team can help you check before you order.

settings.question: How do I clean it?
settings.answer: Wipe the outer fabric with a damp cloth. Do not submerge the unit in water — full care instructions are included in the box.

settings.question: What's your returns policy?
settings.answer: If it's not right for you, send it back within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

settings.question: How fast is delivery?
settings.answer: Standard UK delivery takes 3–5 working days and is tracked door to door. Delivery is free on orders over £40.
